question: The first senior National Handball Championship was held at Rohtak (Haryana) in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1972**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

• The **first Senior National Handball Championship** was held in **1972** at **Rohtak, Haryana**, marking the beginning of organized handball competitions in India.

• It was conducted under the auspices of the **Handball Federation of India (HFI)**, which was established in the same year, i.e., **1972**.

• The championship aimed to promote the game of handball across the country and encourage participation from various states and regions.

• The **venue, Rohtak**, located in Haryana, was chosen due to its infrastructural capacity and active sports culture during that period.

• The event laid the foundation for the development of handball in India, contributing significantly to the sport’s popularity and structure over the years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__

• **Handball Federation of India (HFI):**

• The **Handball Federation of India** was established in **1972** and is the official governing body for handball in India.

• It is affiliated with the **International Handball Federation (IHF)** and the **Asian Handball Federation (AHF)**.

• The HFI is responsible for organizing national-level championships and selecting players for international tournaments.

• **Development of Handball in India:**

• Handball was introduced in India in the early **1970s** and gained traction due to its fast-paced and engaging nature.

• Since the **first Senior National Championship** in 1972, the sport has witnessed steady growth with increased participation across states.

• India has also participated in various international handball events, showcasing its improving skills and competitiveness.

• **Importance of Rohtak in Indian Sports:**

• Rohtak, located in Haryana, is known as a hub for several sports, including wrestling, boxing, and handball.

• The city has produced numerous national and international athletes due to its focus on sports infrastructure and training facilities.

• Haryana, as a state, is recognized for its significant contribution to Indian sports culture and achievements.

• **Other Key Milestones in Indian Handball:**

• The **Junior National Handball Championship** was introduced later to nurture young talent in the sport.

• The Indian handball teams, both men and women, have represented the nation in several Asian Games and other international tournaments.

• Efforts are ongoing to popularize handball in schools and colleges to build a strong grassroots foundation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

• **Handball as a Sport:**

• Handball is a high-speed, team-based sport that combines elements of basketball, soccer, and water polo.

• The game is played on a court measuring **40x20 meters**, with goals at each end.

• A standard handball team consists of **seven players** (six outfield players and a goalkeeper).

• The objective is to score goals by throwing the ball into the opponent's net, with each game divided into two halves of **30 minutes**.

• **Global Handball Events:**

• The **World Handball Championship** is organized by the International Handball Federation (IHF) for both men and women.

• Handball has been a part of the **Olympic Games** since **1936** (official inclusion for men in 1972 and for women in 1976).

• Countries like **Denmark, France, and Norway** have dominated the sport on the international stage.
